jobs.occupation: SAP Digital Manufacturing Solution Consultant – Principal - Skövde
jobs.description:
Integro Consulting is looking for an experienced SAP Digital Manufacturing Solution Consultant for a consulting assignment with our client in Skövde.
Are you passionate about translating business needs into effective technical solutions? Do you enjoy working closely with manufacturing sites, business stakeholders, and development teams? This is an opportunity to contribute to the development and maintenance of production-critical IT systems in a global manufacturing environment.
About the Assignment
You will join our client's global team, responsible for the entire lifecycle of manufacturing IT solutions, from requirements gathering and implementation to maintenance and continuous improvement.
Your primary focus will be SAP Digital Manufacturing (SAP DM), where you will translate business requirements into reliable solutions through hands-on configuration and collaboration with development teams.
Our client is transitioning towards a more agile, product-oriented way of working, with a focus on improving delivery speed, quality, and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with manufacturing sites and stakeholders to understand business requirements.
Design and configure Production Process Designs (PPDs) and Production Operator Dashboards (PODs) in SAP DM.
Support implementations, global rollouts, system upgrades, and quarterly SAP DM releases.
Provide technical support and expertise to manufacturing sites.
Maintain and continuously improve manufacturing IT applications.
Collaborate with development teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
Participate in the on-call rotation for production-critical systems.

Required Qualifications
Hands-on experience implementing and configuring SAP Digital Manufacturing (SAP DM).
Experience with SAP integrations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and spoken English.
A structured, quality-focused approach and strong communication skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders.

Meritorious experience:
Background in the automotive industry.
Experience with manufacturing IT and production environments.
Experience working in agile teams or product-oriented organizations.

Who Are You?
You are an analytical and proactive professional who takes ownership and enjoys turning complex business needs into practical technical solutions. You value teamwork, open communication, and continuous improvement, and you are committed to delivering reliable, high-quality solutions.
Apply Today
Join Integro Consulting and contribute to an exciting consulting assignment with our client, helping shape the future of digital manufacturing.

We seek a Wireless Algorithm Engineer with a strong background in AI research to join the Huawei R&D Wireless Algorithm Lab in Stockholm.
The lab conducts advanced research on wireless algorithms for 5G-Advanced products and future 6G communication systems. By deeply integrating artificial intelligence with wireless communications, they aim to explore intelligent algorithms, data-driven approaches, and AI-native technologies for next-generation wireless systems, and to drive promising research outcomes toward practical systems and products.
The successful candidate should have received systematic academic training in machine learning, deep learning, or related areas, and should be capable of independently conducting cutting-edge AI research.
Responsibilities
Research and develop innovative AI/ML algorithms and models for next-generation wireless communication systems, with applications to optimisation, prediction, and decision-making.
Build and improve simulation environments, datasets, evaluation frameworks, and experimental methodologies required for algorithm research.
Track state-of-the-art developments in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and wireless communications, identify promising research directions, and formulate innovative research topics.

Qualifications
· PhD in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
· Strong academic background in AI/ML with a deep and systematic understanding of the field
Expertise in AI research areas, such as deep learning, representation learning, generative models, sequence modeling, graph learning, reinforcement learning, foundation models, transfer learning, continual learning, or other emerging machine learning technologies.
Proficiency in Python, with hands-on research experience using mainstream deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow;
Strong mathematical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary research and engineering teams.

Preferred Experience
A sustained track record of high-quality publications in leading AI/ML conferences or journals;
Experience applying advanced AI methods to communications, signal processing, control, or other complex engineering systems;
Industrial R&D experience with the ability to balance frontier research value with practical algorithm implementation and deployment considerations.

This is a full-time consultant position.

jobs.occupation: Researcher – Artificial Intelligence and High-Performance Computing
jobs.employer_name: RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB
jobs.description:
About the position
The convergence of high-performance computing and artificial intelligence is transforming how research is done, how industry innovates, and how society solves its most complex challenges. We are now strengthening our High-Performance Computing (HPC) group with a researcher who can work at exactly this intersection - combining deep expertise in AI and HPC to help researchers, companies and public organisations make effective use of Europe's most powerful computing infrastructure.
You will join a team that works across the full innovation chain, from methodological development to applied science and societal deployment, ensuring that advanced computing translates into real impact. At the core of our activities is Sweden AI Factory, one of the European AI Factories established under the European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking (EuroHPC JU) and co-operated by RISE and NAISS, as well as ENCCS, the Swedish national competence centre in HPC. You will work across ENCCS, Sweden AI Factory and related initiatives - both EuroHPC-funded projects and projects supported by other European and national funders.
What you will do

Develop, scale and apply AI methods - from deep learning to large language and other foundation models - to real-world problems, in collaboration with industrial and academic partners.

Design, run, and optimise large-scale training and simulation workloads on GPU-accelerated European supercomputers.

Act as a technical expert and advisor to companies and public sector organisations, from startups and SMEs to large industry, helping them identify how HPC and AI can be put to work in their own domain.

Contribute to the design and delivery of training activities - workshops, hands-on labs and hackathons - that build HPC and AI competence in Swedish research and industry.

Contribute to ENCCS, Sweden AI Factory and related EuroHPC-funded and other national and European projects, and take an active role in preparing proposals for new funding from the EU and national agencies.

Represent RISE in international HPC and AI conferences, workshops, and community initiatives, and help build cross-border collaboration with other AI Factories, Centres of Excellence, and National Competence Centres.

Who we are looking for
Required:

PhD or equivalent experience in computer science, applied or computational mathematics, computational science, or a related field.

Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.

Demonstrated experience of distributed training and parallel computing on GPU-accelerated HPC systems (e.g. PyTorch DDP/FSDP, DeepSpeed or Megatron-LM, MPI, CUDA or ROCm), including batch scheduling with Slurm.

Experience of applying AI and machine learning to real-world research or industrial problems, working with real, imperfect data.

Experience of organising or teaching courses, summer schools, workshops, or other training activities.

Excellent communication skills in English, and a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical results into clear recommendations for non-specialist audiences.

Meritorious:

Experience of training, fine-tuning, or deploying large-scale models, such as large language models or other foundation models, on HPC systems.

Experience of efficient inference and model serving (e.g. vLLM, quantisation), containerised workflows (e.g. Apptainer), or MLOps practices on shared infrastructure.

Experience of contributing to funding proposals to EU programmes (e.g. Horizon Europe, Digital Europe) or national funding agencies.

Experience of collaborative projects with industrial partners, including delivering results and reviews to industry stakeholders.

Experience of supervising students, thesis workers, or junior engineers.

Familiarity with the European research computing landscape (EuroHPC, AI Factories, national HPC centres), and experience of leading proposals or work packages in EU projects.

Familiarity with trustworthy AI, data governance, and the regulatory landscape, including the EU AI Act.

A strong scientific publication record.

Communication skills in Swedish.

We place great weight on personal qualities. You are curious and independent, comfortable moving between deep technical work and the applied needs of an external partner, and you enjoy working in a team where knowledge is shared openly. Swedish language skills are not a requirement - our working language is English, and we support employees who wish to learn Swedish.
Are we right for each other?
At RISE, we like different and we are convinced that diversity contributes to an innovative environment where we together challenge boundaries and develop new knowledge for the future. With us, passionate problem solvers meet to solve some of the world's most important, and perhaps fun, problems. We can not promise you an easy job, but what we can promise you is a bunch of committed colleagues and some really exciting societal and industrial challenges to tackle. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. With us, you get the opportunity to make a real difference. Welcome to the entire Swedish research institute and innovation partners!
Welcome with Your Application!
For more information, please contact the recruiting manager Thor Wikfeldt, Group Manager, at thor.wikfeldt@ri.se. The last application date is December 20. Selection and interviews will be conducted continuously during and after the application period. Apply without cover letter.
Our union representatives are Ingemar Petermann, SACO, +46 10 228 41 22 and Linda Ikatti, Unionen, +46 10 516 51 61.

Area of interest: Sales & Marketing
 
Shape the Future of Poultry Health in the Nordics
 
At HIPRA, prevention is at the heart of everything we do.
As a global biotechnology company focused on innovation, vaccines, and animal health solutions, we work alongside veterinarians and producers to improve animal health, welfare, and productivity. Through science, technology, and a strong commitment to prevention, we help shape the future of animal health worldwide.
HIPRA NORDIC is responsible for the sale and promotion of HIPRA products across Denmark, Sweden, and Norway. We are now looking for a Technical & Marketing Manager Poultry to lead and develop our poultry business throughout the Nordic region.
This is a unique opportunity to combine technical expertise, commercial vision, and market development in a highly visible role with responsibility across three countries.
 
Your Mission
As Technical & Marketing Manager Poultry, you will drive the development of HIPRA's poultry business across Denmark, Sweden, and Norway.
Through technical expertise, customer engagement, and strategic market development, you will strengthen HIPRA's position as a trusted partner to poultry producers and veterinarians while promoting our prevention strategy and innovative solutions.
You will work closely with customers, key industry stakeholders, colleagues across the Nordic organization, and HIPRA's Poultry Team at headquarters in Spain. As part of a small and agile Nordic organization of 12 employees, you will enjoy a high level of visibility and influence while working closely with colleagues across functions and countries. At the same time, you will have access to the expertise, innovation, and support of HIPRA's international poultry network.
 
Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement the poultry business strategy across the Nordic region.
Identify market opportunities and translate customer insights into business initiatives.
Analyze market developments, customer needs, disease trends, and competitive activity.
Support the successful launch and implementation of products and services.
Provide technical and scientific support to customers and internal teams.
Deliver product training, workshops, and scientific presentations.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key opinion leaders and industry stakeholders.
Partner closely with sales colleagues to identify opportunities and support business growth.
Contribute to marketing initiatives and ensure effective local execution.
Collaborate with Nordic and international colleagues to share best practices and drive continuous improvement.

 
Who We Are Looking For
You are a veterinary professional who enjoys combining science, business, and relationship building. You are motivated by helping customers succeed and thrive in an environment where you can make a visible impact.
 
Qualifications
Degree in Veterinary Medicine.
Preferably 3+ years of experience within the poultry industry, poultry health, or animal health sector.
Good knowledge and understanding of the Nordic poultry market.
Experience in poultry production, poultry health, vaccination programs, or animal health will be considered an advantage.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Ability to build trusted relationships with customers and stakeholders.
Strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution.
Strong planning, organizational, and project management skills.
Positive, proactive, and customer-focused mindset.

 
Language Requirements
English is the corporate language within HIPRA, and a strong command of English is required.
Candidates must also be fluent in at least one Scandinavian language (Danish, Swedish, or Norwegian). Given the Nordic scope of the role, Scandinavian language skills and an understanding of the Nordic market are essential.
 
Location & Travel
The successful candidate can be based in Denmark, Sweden, or Norway.
This is primarily a home-based position with regular travel to customers, meetings, congresses, and industry events throughout the Nordic region. Significant travel across the Nordic countries should therefore be expected.
 
HIPRA Nordic's office is located in Vejen, Denmark.
 
Why Join HIPRA?
Take ownership of the poultry business across Denmark, Sweden, and Norway.
Join a global animal health company recognized for innovation and prevention.
Work in a highly visible role with significant influence and responsibility.
Be part of a small, collaborative Nordic team with strong international support.
Collaborate with industry experts, key customers, and global colleagues.
Enjoy a flexible, home-based work environment.
Access continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
Contribute to a company dedicated to improving animal health and supporting sustainable food production.

 
Interested?
If you are passionate about poultry health and excited by the opportunity to combine technical expertise, commercial insight, and market development in an international environment, we would love to hear from you. Applications will be considered continuously as we receive them, so don’t hesitate to submit yours.
If you have any questions to the position, you are welcome to contact the Business Manager:
Camilla.velvin@hipra.com, phone +47 9366 5174
 
Apply by submitting your CV and cover letter.
 
 
HIPRA offers equal opportunity to all of its employees.
All qualified applicants will be considered for the position to be filled, without regard to gender, race, nationality, disability or age.All hiring decisions are made on the basis of merit, competence and the needs of the company.

Job Description
Are you an experienced media relations professional who knows how to turn complex topics into clear, credible stories? We are looking for a Press Officer & Communications Specialist to join the H&M Global Communications Media Relations & Reputation team. In this role, you will help tell our story, build trust and protect the reputation of H&M and H&M Group. 
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
You will work both proactively and reactively across a broad range of topics. As a trusted media expert, you will research issues, develop messages and create timely responses for Swedish and international media. You will collaborate closely with colleagues and spokespeople across H&M Group functions, H&M at global and sales-market level and the other brands within H&M Group. 
Your responsibilities will include: 
Responding to incoming media enquiries and taking part in regular press duty 
Drafting messages, Q&As, statements, press releases and other communications materials 
Acting as a spokesperson for H&M Group when appointed 
Initiating proactive media strategies and stories, interviews and engaging content together with functions and brands  
Organising and participating in interviews, press events, press trips and meetings with media 
Maintaining and developing relationships with key media and opinion formers 
Advising and supporting global and local spokespeople and communications colleagues on media-related matters and crisis communications  
Preparing interview briefs and delivering communications and media training 
Using media analysis tools to identify opportunities, risks and follow-up actions 
Following up budgets and performance for the projects you manage and contributing to the team’s overall goals 

WHO YOU ARE 
You are curious, proactive and motivated to investigate new topics and find the facts and proof points needed to build credible communications. You combine sound judgement with a positive, collaborative and non-prestigious approach. You can prioritise effectively, stay focused when the pace is high and work independently while contributing actively to the team. 
To succeed in this role, we believe you have... 
An academic background in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Business or an equivalent higher-level education 
At least five years of experience in communications or media relations, ideally from a listed company or communications agency 
Strong knowledge of how the media works and an understanding of the corporate media landscape 
A strong interest in current affairs, global trends and developments relevant to our industry, with the ability to identify potential stories, opportunities and risks 
Excellent writing and communication skills in both English and Swedish. Additional language skills are an advantage 
The ability to communicate key messages clearly, creatively and persuasively 
Strong relationship-building skills and the confidence to coach and advise colleagues, spokespeople and partners 
A structured and methodical way of working, with strong attention to detail and planning skills 

You bring a passion for storytelling and an inclusive, service-minded approach. You are flexible, decisive and action-oriented, and you continuously look for ways to improve how we work. 
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
This is a full-time permanent position based at our Head Office at Sveavägen 44 in Stockholm. If you feel that your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, please submit your CV in English at your earliest opportunity. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 
WHO WE ARE 
 
H&M Group is a global family of brands and businesses. We make it possible for customers around the world to express themselves through fashion and design. We are a family of strong fashion brands, including H&M, COS, Weekday, Cheap Monday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Sellpy and Singular Society. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.   
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.  
An example of our benefits:  
25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online, including H&M, COS, Weekday, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET. 
H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Learn more about the program here.  
With a presence in markets around the world, we offer extensive career development and opportunities for international mobility. 

JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things — our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. 
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

Lead the next phase of our enterprise sales growth across Europe. As Head of Enterprise Sales Europe at Tool Flow Solutions, you lead and develop the regional sales team while staying close to the business yourself, winning new TDM customers, and growing strategic customer relationships. 
About Tool Flow Solutions 
Tool Flow Solutions is Sandvik’s digital tool-management business, helping manufacturers manage tools and tooling data more effectively. Our portfolio brings together TDM, Toolhive and Cribwise, covering different customer needs and levels of complexity, from enterprise-wide tool-data and process management to cloud-based tool management and inventory control.   
In this position, you lead the European sales organization focused primarily on TDM solutions, while working closely with our Digital Sales team and other functions to identify opportunities across the broader portfolio and provide customers with the right solution. 
About the job 
You drive profitable enterprise sales growth across Europe by translating commercial priorities into clear regional plans and disciplined execution. Combining leadership with active involvement in strategic opportunities, you secure new TDM customers, expand existing accounts, and strengthen relationships with customers and partners. You report to the Head of Sales & Marketing, Tool Flow Solutions.  
Job responsibilities 
Lead, coach and develop the European enterprise sales team across different countries. 
Drive enterprise sales processes from qualification and discovery through negotiation and closing. 
Own the European TDM sales pipeline, CRM discipline and evidence-based forecasting. 
Develop and execute regional sales plans to grow new businesses and expand existing strategic customer relationships. 
Build business through direct sales, resellers, Sandvik companies and other relevant partners. 
Strengthen collaboration across the wider commercial organization, bringing together Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Product around key opportunities and customer needs. 
Support Toolhive and Cribwise opportunities in coordination with the Digital Sales team.  

Location and flexibility 
This position is based in Tübingen, Germany, or Stockholm, Sweden, with a hybrid working arrangement. Travel within Europe and occasional travel outside the region are required.  
Your profile 
You’re an experienced sales leader with significant B2B enterprise software or industrial technology sales experience, and you lead from the front. You combine people leadership with hands-on sales execution – building practical sales plans, coaching your team in real customer situations, and bringing the drive to turn plans into results. Your background includes complex buying processes, enterprise account growth, and cross-border collaboration.  
Your background includes: 
Proven experience leading and coaching sales teams across countries, with a clear focus on improving performance and execution. 
A strong track record of winning complex enterprise deals and expanding established customer accounts. 
Experience working with CRM, structured opportunity qualification, pipeline reviews, and sales forecasting. 
A university degree in business administration, engineering, industrial technology or a related field, or equivalent professional education and experience. 
Strong English and German communication and presentation skills.  

Experience from manufacturing, software integration, resellers, or distribution is highly relevant. Knowledge of tool-management software, TDM, subscription or cloud offerings is an advantage, as are other European language skills. 
Being hands-on and commercially minded, you bring structure and momentum to both individual opportunities and team performance. You build trust across cultures and functions, challenge assumptions constructively, and remain resilient when priorities or market conditions change. With a coaching approach and strong ownership, you help people develop while keeping customers and results firmly in focus. 
The team 
You lead enterprise sales professionals located across Europe. The team works across countries and collaborates closely with Digital Sales, Marketing, Sales Operations, Product, Customer Success, implementation teams and regional partners.  
Our culture 
Our role is clear – through every action, every day, we make the shift and advance the world through engineering. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career options.  Are you intrigued? Visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.   
Contact information 
For further information about this position, please contact Oskar Edqvist, hiring manager, oskar.edqvist@sandvik.com

How to apply 
Send your application no later than December 10, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0100094.

Job Description
ABOUT TECH ACADEMY 
 
Tech Academy exists to empower H&M Tech colleagues to build the skills they need to deliver on business needs. By strengthening key tech capabilities and creating a strong learning culture, we help make technology a competitive advantage for H&M. 
 
We do this through two main offerings: Academy Initiatives, leadership-sponsored programs that build business-critical skills at scale and Explore & Learn, platforms, events and communities that support employees’ own development 
 
JOB DESCRIPTION 
As Learning Experience Designer, you’ll play an important role in shaping how H&M Tech colleagues learn and build new capabilities. You’ll turn Tech Academy’s priorities into engaging learning experiences that build real capability and make a difference to business results. 
 
In this role, you will turn Tech Academy’s priorities into well-designed, engaging learning experiences that make a real difference to how H&M Tech colleagues deliver business results. You will work closely with the Tech Academy team, Tech Centers, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and the People organization to support upskilling within prioritized skill areas. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO  
This is a hands-on role for a person who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and enjoys turning complex technical knowledge into engaging, learner-centered experiences that build real skills through practice. 
 
Key responsibilities include: 
Analyze tech upskilling and performance needs, translating them into clear learning objectives and effective learning experiences. 
Lead the design of engaging, interactive learning experiences, from scenario-based digital learning to workshops and micro-learning, in collaboration with SMEs and external partners. 
Partner with and coach SMEs to translate their experience into effective learning experiences. 
Prototype and pilot learning experiences with learners, and plan, facilitate and deliver tech-focused learning events. 
Design and manage the Tech Academy channel in our Learning Experience Platform (LXP), creating structured learning journeys based on roles and skills. 
Design content and activities for communities of practice and learning campaigns that keep colleagues engaged and make offerings easy to find. 
Set clear KPIs, evaluate the effectiveness and impact of learning initiatives and use learner feedback and data to continuously improve them.  
Partner with external learning providers and tech partners, such as Microsoft and Google Cloud, to integrate their expertise into learning experiences. 
Explore and apply AI-enabled ways of designing, building and delivering learning where they improve the learner experience 

WHO YOU ARE  
You’re a learner-centered designer who understands how great learning experiences can build skills and create business impact. You enjoy working collaboratively in a large, complex organisation and are comfortable navigating ambiguity. 
You communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences and can advise stakeholders on how people learn best. You’re also comfortable taking ownership and bringing an idea from an identified learning need through to a finished experience. 
We are looking for people with... 
7+ years of proven experience in learning experience design (instructional design, needs analysis, learning journey design, evaluation), backed by a portfolio and grounded in learning science, such as adult learning theory, plus facilitation and delivery experience (training, coaching, mentoring) 
Experience designing interactive learning in a tech environment, translating technical content into hands-on experiences with meaningful practice, such as scenarios and simulations, ideally going beyond linear, click-through eLearning 
Hands-on experience with rapid authoring tools (e.g., Articulate 360, or similar) and LXP systems (e.g., EdCast, or similar) and designing learning experiences within them 
Experience using learner feedback and data to evaluate and improve learning, ideally including learning analytics and impact measurement 
Strong project management and stakeholder collaboration skills, with experience leading complex initiatives from early idea to finished learning experience 
Fluency in English, written and spoken, and experience working in global, complex matrix organizations 
Experience using AI as an enabler in learning design is an advantage 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 
This is a permanent position based from our Head Office in Marievik, Stockholm. The role is office-based, with a general expectation of being onsite four days a week. If this sounds like an opportunity for you, we’d be happy to hear from you. Please submit you CV in English and a portfolio at your earliest availability.

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here 

JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it is our people who make us who we are. 
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

Southern Swedish Forest Research Centre
Third-cycle subject area
Forest Management
Description of the doctoral project
 
Douglas-fir is a promising alternative for diversifying Swedish production forests under a changing climate. Its wider use requires better knowledge of needle diseases that can cause needle loss, crown thinning and reduced growth. This four-year PhD project will investigate how host genetics, fungal communities and environmental conditions influence Douglas-fir health and productivity. It will examine disease patterns across Swedish growing conditions, identify the fungi involved and explore genetic variation in a major needle-disease pathogen. The project will also investigate differences in resistance and tolerance among provenances and how disease affects growth. The aim is to support the selection of suitable planting material and sites for future forestry.
The project is based at the Southern Swedish Forest Research Centre in Alnarp, in collaboration with Skogforsk, Södra and international researchers. The doctoral student will join a multidisciplinary forestry research environment. The project combines field surveys and established forestry trials with fungal diagnostics, sequencing and population genetics analysis.
 
About the position
The doctoral student will plan and conduct field and laboratory studies, manage and analyse data, write scientific papers and a doctoral thesis, and communicate results through conferences and dialogue with project partners. Work includes field surveys and sampling at sites across Sweden, microscopy, fungal isolation and culturing, molecular identification, sequencing-based analyses and statistical modelling. The student will complete relevant doctoral courses and progressively develop independence in research planning, analysis and scientific writing.
Requirements
To meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).
Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in Forest Management. To meet the specific entry requirements, you must have at least 90 credits in subjects relevant to Forest Management, including at least 30 credits at second-cycle level. 
You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.
Your profile
We are looking for a motivated candidate with a strong interest in forest pathology and in how tree genetics and environmental conditions influence disease and forest productivity.
Required qualifications:
University education in forestry is essential. Applicants must have a Master’s degree in forestry or forest science, or an equivalent degree with a substantial forestry component, and meet the eligibility requirements above.
Documented practical experience in forest pathology, acquired through a degree project, research or relevant employment, including assessment or diagnosis of fungal diseases of forest trees.
A sound understanding of forest ecology and silviculture, and basic competence in experimental design and statistical data analysis.
Ability to communicate scientific work clearly in spoken and written English.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively, organise field and laboratory work, and undertake fieldwork involving travel within Sweden.
The following are considered merits:
Experience of forest health surveys, disease assessment, needle or crown condition assessments, or work in forestry field trials.
Experience of microscopy, fungal isolation and culturing, or morphological identification of fungi.
Experience of DNA extraction, PCR, sequence-based fungal identification or other molecular diagnostic methods.
Experience of high-throughput sequencing, ITS metabarcoding, bioinformatics or analysis of fungal community data.
Knowledge of population genetics, molecular markers, phylogenetic analysis or pathogen population structure.
Experience of statistical analysis in R or comparable software, particularly mixed models, multivariate analysis, or integration of climate, site and growth data.
Knowledge of Swedish or another Scandinavian language, or willingness to learn Swedish, and a valid driving licence.
About us
The Southern Swedish Forest Research Centre conducts research and teaching on sustainable forestry, with expertise in silviculture, forest ecology, forest pathology, forest policy and planning. We work closely with partners in the forest sector and offer a collegial, international research environment at SLU’s Alnarp campus. The doctoral student will join the department’s forest pathology research environment and a multidisciplinary network of researchers and practitioners.

Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/
